title: Xdrip and accu-check Mobile?
body:
I was wondering if anyone could help me connect my accu-check mobile with the wireless adapter to xdrip? 
Currently I can see the device in a Bluetooth search - connects but then I get a "timed out on: notify new glucose record." Any help?!

comments.body: This issue is not filled according to the template. We do not know anything about your environment. Also, please ask for help at the [Community support forums](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/new/choose), first.

Closing due to inactivity.
Please do research as suggested already using the support channels.
